template.Name: Community Program Registration
template.Confirmation_Page_Message__c:
Thank you, {{Contact1_First_Name__c}}. Your registration for Riverside Community Garden's growing workshops is in, and your signed release is saved with it.

These workshops are how neighbors learn to grow food together, and knowing who is coming lets us plan seeds, tools and space for everyone.

Within [two business days] we will email {{Contact1_Email__c}} with your workshop date, what to bring and where to meet. Questions in the meantime? Write to [program contact] and we will help.
template.Offline_Message__c:
Registration for the growing workshops is closed right now.

To hear when the next session opens, write to [program contact].
